Test Case 4: GitHub CLI Authentication Validation

Input:
- Pod: devbob-0, devbob-1, devbob-2
- Command: gh auth status

Expected Output (when authenticated):
- Logged in to github.com
- ✓ Token: ghp_***
- OR: gh.io/oauth_token set

Expected Output (when NOT authenticated):
- You are not logged into any GitHub hosts
- Run 'gh auth login' to authenticate

Validation:
- Check for 'Logged in to github.com' (PASS)
- OR: Check for 'not logged into any GitHub hosts' (FAIL)
- Critical for PR operations - must be authenticated
